steps.title: Analyze and Plan 3D Rendering Architecture
steps.description: Design a highly-optimized, dependency-free 3D projection engine utilizing standard Android Canvas, coordinate matrices, and Painter's sorting algorithm.

steps.title: Define Multi-Tab Workspace UI Layout
steps.description: Create a rich multi-control design layout in activity_main.xml featuring a dedicated 3D viewport, real-time parameters, color material sliders, and custom presets.

steps.title: Configure App Metadata
steps.description: Create the app-meta.json file defining the application name and standard package structure identifiers.

steps.title: Implement 3D Coordinate Mathematical Structures
steps.description: Declare Vertex and Face structures in MainActivity to store 3D points, compute vectors, and handle polygons.

steps.title: Define 3D Mesh Presets Engine
steps.description: Build high-quality parametric wireframes and mesh presets for Cube, Pyramid, Triangular Prism, Cylinder, and UV Sphere.

steps.title: Implement Perspective Projection and Scaling
steps.description: Apply perspective divisor projection formulas to map rotated 3D models accurately onto the 2D device screen space.

steps.title: Implement Painter's Algorithm for Face Sorting
steps.description: Program back-to-front polygon depth sorting relative to camera location to resolve structural overlap and occlusion visual issues.

steps.title: Build Realistic Diffuse Lighting Shader
steps.description: Apply cross-product math to compute surface normals and calculate dynamic shading brightness under customized light source directions.

steps.title: Design Drag and Rotate Touch Controller
steps.description: Implement gesture-driven rotate, pan, and transform events to allow users to intuitively rotate models on X and Y axes.

steps.title: Develop 3D Project Serialization Engine
steps.description: Design dynamic saving and loading features in SharedPreferences to let users store custom shapes, scales, colors, and layouts.

steps.title: Verify Manifest and Gradle Standards
steps.description: Ensure compilation configs align perfectly with targeted Android SDK 34 and compatible system theme definitions.

steps.title: Building 3D Design Studio
steps.description: Run standard Gradle compiler processes to bundle resources, assemble debug classes, and create the finalized package installer.
